widgetTool.name: mortgage_rate_shelf
widgetTool.description: Emit the current mortgage rate shelf. Requires financial advice disclaimer and CDIC disclosure. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'Let me show you our current mortgage rates.'

break_even_month.description: Month at which cumulative projected variable interest passes the best fixed. 0 means it never does within the horizon.

summary.description: One plain sentence from mortgage_rate_board. Render verbatim; never rewrite it.

variable_advantage_over_horizon_cad.description: Positive means variable is ahead across the term, negative means behind.

break_even.description: Shown only inside the variable product's expanded detail. Copy straight from mortgage_rate_board.

confirm_cta_label.description: Primary button label. Use the {product} placeholder to echo the selected product name.

confirm_cta_value.description: Sent back to the agent on tap. The widget appends the selected product as JSON.

expand_projection.description: Open the variable product's projection chart on load instead of leaving it behind the 'what we project' toggle. Set true when the customer asked to COMPARE fixed against variable -- the chart and the break-even month are the answer to that question. Leave false/absent when they are choosing a rate.

name.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'mortgage_rate_shelf'

payments_per_year.description: So the widget can label each payment figure with the right cadence.

prime_rate_pct.description: Shown as the basis for every variable product.

products.description: Required. The rate shelf from mortgage_rate_board, in the order returned. Never reorder, never invent a rate.

badge.description: Pipe-separated badges, e.g. 'Lowest today | Payment locked'.

blurb.description: One short line on who the product suits.

monthly_equivalent_cad.description: Used to compare products on a like-for-like monthly basis.

payment_per_period_cad.description: The headline figure on the row, at the customer's chosen frequency.

rate_basis.description: How the rate is built, e.g. 'Prime 4.45% minus 1.1%'. Shown small under the rate.

rate_type.description: fixed | variable. Selecting a variable product reveals the projection.

recommended.description: Pre-selects the row. Never described to the customer as advice.

rate_hold_days.description: Shown as a footnote, e.g. 120. Omit or set 0 to hide.

type.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'custom_template'

variable_projection.description: Projected variable rate path, plotted as a sparkline inside the variable product's detail. Must always be labelled a projection, never a promise.

variable_projection_disclaimer.description: Required whenever variable_projection is supplied. Rendered verbatim beneath the chart.
